**Fab Shift Log Summary:**

- **Chamber Pressure Drift:** Chambers 1, 13, 25, and 37 experienced slight overnight pressure drifts, all within tolerance.
- **Defects & Hold:** A cracked focus ring in etcher 7 caused a killer defect cluster on wafer W-24-0917, leading to a hold on lot LOT-7F2A-1183.
- **Maintenance & Replacements:**
  - CMP pads replaced on polishers 5, 17, and 29.
  - Photoresist batches swapped on tracks 3, 15, 27, and 39 (no recipe changes).
  - Probe cards 12 and 24 cleaned, contact resistance returned to normal.
  - Wet bench 10, 22, and 34 chemistries refreshed on schedule.
- **Process Performance:**
  - Defect densities near line average on runs 6, 18, and 3
